items.context: WhaleNoName (@WhaleNoName, 52.603 seguidores, en inglés), post con gráfico/video: sostiene que cada ciclo tuvo su "cisne negro" (2020 COVID, 2022 FTX) y que ahora se repite el patrón de doble golpe: primera caída a $57.800, rebote a $87.300 que parece piso, y segundo golpe a $55.000, esta vez con la caída de ~50% de Nvidia como catalizador. Cierra: no confundir el primer rebote con el fin del mercado bajista. ~12 min, 23 likes, 10 guardados, 4 respuestas, 1,6K vistas (despegando).
items.suggested_text:
The double punch is real, but the data says the bigger trap is usually time, not the second low. In 2013 Bitcoin printed two peaks: one was reclaimed in 210 days, the other took 1,177. Same year, same asset, a completely different experience depending on which "bottom" you trusted.

That's why the first bounce fools people. A relief rally after capitulation feels like confirmation, but the drawdowns that hurt most are the ones that grind sideways long enough for conviction to run out. The 2011 cycle fell -92.7% and still needed 622 days just to get back to the prior high.

COVID, FTX, now Nvidia: the catalyst decides when the flush happens. What decides when it ends is a different question.
